entry.note: Identified from the title page and arXiv stamp (arXiv:1610.02592v3, math.GT, 5 Apr 2022): Bruno Martelli, 'An Introduction to Geometric Topology', 494 pp, 68 sections (self-published graduate textbook). No ref() entry existed; docs/audits/2026-09-06-hyperbolic-surface-law.md line 144 and bean qou-j8hp listed it as 'absent — optional'. Entry martelli2016 created 2026-09-06; no citation site yet.

relevance.rationale: A textbook, so 'supporting' by construction — it derives nothing the folio does not already take from thurston1978 / neumann-zagier1985 / benedetti-petronio / ratcliffe — but it is the first HELD, sectioned, greppable source for the exact statements the NZ-from-braid chain (docs/audits/2026-09-06-nz-gluing-data-from-braid-monodromy.md, beans qou-n2cl / qou-yvyd) checks against. Read for this triage: §13.1 (Thm 13.1.3, Cor 13.1.4), §14.1 (14.1.1–14.1.7: ideal tetrahedra as a single shape z, ideal triangulations, Prop 14.1.7 consistency + completeness ⇒ complete finite-volume hyperbolic structure, Prop 14.1.8 valence-6 triangulations at z = e^{iπ/3}, Fig 14.7 + §14.1.7 identifying that two-tetrahedron triangulation as the figure-eight complement, Thm 14.1.10 the torus/satellite/hyperbolic trichotomy), §15.1 (Thm 15.1.1 hyperbolic Dehn filling, Table 15.1 exceptional surgeries of 4_1), §15.2 (Prop 15.2.1, Cor 15.2.8, Prop 15.2.9 / 15.2.11 Lagrangian rows, the solution space as a complex manifold parametrised by peripheral holonomy), and §11.3–11.4 (Dehn surgery, torus bundles, Prop 11.4.14 Anosov monodromy). Each of these is a claim the corpus currently makes with a citation to Thurston's notes or NZ; Martelli gives numbered, held statements. What it does NOT contain, checked by grep: the Floyd–Hatcher punctured-torus-bundle layering and Guéritaud's two-bridge layered triangulations (no 'punctured torus', 'Farey', 'two-bridge' or 'layered' hits outside a caption), so it cannot replace library arxiv-0808.2716v4 for qou-yvyd; and it treats only closed torus bundles in §11.4. Per the owner's instruction the two-bridge work is not attempted here — this row records the citation only.

keyResults.statement: For an ideal triangulation with n tetrahedra and c cusps, a shape vector with Im z_i > 0 satisfying the n consistency (edge) and 2c completeness (cusp) equations defines a complete finite-volume hyperbolic metric on M.
keyResults.useForFolio: The held statement behind prop:hyperbolic-knot-shape-fields and prop:gluing-equations-do-not-detect-hyperbolicity (both cite thurston1978 + neumann-zagier1985 only), and behind step 4 of the NZ-from-braid chain.

keyResults.statement: A triangulation whose edges all have valence six is solved by z = e^{iπ/3} throughout (all tetrahedra regular); the two-tetrahedron, two-edge instance is the figure-eight knot complement.
keyResults.useForFolio: Literature form of the audit's §2 exact-solution check z_0 = z_1 = ω (ω² − ω + 1 = 0) and of QOU.Mass.FigureEightGluingFromMonodromy.figure_eight_gluing_at_sixth_root; a -- Ref: for that Lean docstring.

keyResults.statement: #edges = #tetrahedra; the incidence matrix A has rank 2n − c; its rows generate a Lagrangian subspace for the (degenerate) symplectic form on shape-parameter space; the solution space of the consistency equations is a complex manifold parametrised by peripheral holonomy.
keyResults.useForFolio: The audit's 'NZ symplectic' check (edge rows isotropic, ω(μ,λ) = ±2) is Prop 15.2.9's statement; qou-yvyd's cross-knot gate can cite Cor 15.2.8 for the expected rank of the derived edge rows.

keyResults.statement: Vol(Δ) = Λ(α) + Λ(β) + Λ(γ) for an ideal tetrahedron with dihedral angles α, β, γ (Lobachevsky function Λ), maximised by the regular ideal tetrahedron.
keyResults.useForFolio: A held source for the Λ-form of the Vol(4_1) = 6Λ(π/3) = 2·Cl_2(π/3) coefficient guard (AGENTS.md; bean qou-zdz5) — the corpus's 'Λ vs Cl_2' drain can cite the definition it is correcting to.
